request: count rounds around the ground when I jog. +1 button, lap length 400 m, show distance
program:
app "Run rounds" run mint
table run km num 0.1..100
state left num = 100
state going bool = no
every 1s if going set left = left - 1
when going and left <= 0 set going = no then add run km = max(run, if(it.km < round(it.km * 400 / 10), 1, 0))
draw 100, 40 width 220
  circle 50, 50, 44 fill accent opacity 0.8
  circle 50, 50, 44 * 92 fill good opacity 0.8
  label 50, 50, round(12 * 92) "%" big
"Total run" sum(run.km) faint
describe:
Run rounds, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- run: km: number, 0.1 to 100. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: left, starting at 100; going, starting at no.
Shows:
- every 1 seconds while going, it sets left to left minus 1.
- when going and left is at most 0, it sets going to no, then adds a run with km set to the highest of 1 when its km is less than its km times 400 divided by 10 rounded, otherwise 0 over the run.
- a drawing made of circles, labels.
- text: "Total run", the total km of run.

sum(sewing.km month) "days since" sum(sewing.km prev month) faint
form sewing, "Log sewing"

describe:
Sewing, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- sewing: what: text; km: number, at least 0; repair: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

request: qaza namaz counter. I have 1200 fajr missed, 900 zuhr, 1000 asr, 800 maghrib, 700 isha, 300 witr. tap when i pray one qaza and it goes down

checklist.item: has the six prayers (fajr, zuhr, asr, maghrib, isha, witr) as separate counts
each prayer has a button to reduce remaining by one
starting numbers are set to the amounts given
shows total remaining across all prayers

program:
app "Choraans" mosque mint
table prayed
setting target num = 1200 " Fajr target"
let n = count(prayed today)
draw 100, 100 width 220 tap add prayed
  circle 50, 50, 46 stroke soft thick 2
  arc 50, 50, 46, 0, 360 * clamp(n / target, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 2
  label 50, 46, n big
  label 50, 64, "of" target faint
"Missed this week" count(prayed week) faint
when n = target notify "Target reached"
describe:
Choraans, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- prayed: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: " Fajr target": number, starts at 1200.
Works out:
- n is how many prayed entries today.
Shows:
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels; a tap adds a prayed.
- text: "Missed this week", how many prayed entries this week.
- when n is target, it shows the notice "Target reached".

request: We are shifting house next month. Track boxes by room (kitchen, bedroom, kids room, living, store) with a label of what is inside and whether it is packed. Would be great if my wife and I could both see it on our phones and sync live.

checklist.item: can add a box with room (pick) and contents label
box has a packed yes/no tick
shows count of boxes packed vs total
list grouped or filtered by room

program:
app "Moving house" home mint
table box what text, room pick Kitchen|Bedroom|Kids|Living|Store = Kitchen, packed bool
"packed" count(box where packed = yes) "of" count(box) head
each options box.room as r
  row card gap 2
    r bold grow
    toggle box where room = r
"Kitchen" count(box where packed = yes) "packed" faint
"Bedroom" count(box where packed = yes) "packed" faint
"Kids" count(box where packed = yes) "packed" faint
"Living" count(box where packed = yes) "packed" faint
"Storage" count(box where packed = yes) "packed" faint
form box, "Add box"
list box where packed = yes
describe:
Moving house, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- box: what: text; room: one of Kitchen, Bedroom, Kids, Living, Store, starts at Kitchen; packed: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "packed", how many box entries where packed is yes, "of", how many box entries.
- for each choice of the room of the box:
  - text: the choice.
  - a tick box for box where room is the choice.
- text: "Kitchen", how many box entries where packed is yes, "packed".
- text: "Bedroom", how many box entries where packed is yes, "packed".
- text: "Kids", how many box entries where packed is yes, "packed".
- text: "Living", how many box entries where packed is yes, "packed".
- text: "Storage", how many box entries where packed is yes, "packed".
- a form to add a box.
- a list of box where packed is yes; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

request: Hajj savings goal 750000 rs. I deposit whenever I can. show progress bar and how much left

checklist.item: can add a deposit with amount and date

program:
app "Hajj" coin mint
table hajj amount money, note text?
setting goal money = 750000 "Total goal"
goal sum(hajj.amount all), goal, "saved"
"Progress bar" round((goal - sum(hajj.amount all)) / max(count(hajj), 1)) big
plot 0..100, 0..max(max(1..100, sum(hajj.amount)), 1) axes
  each 1..100
    rect index + 0.15, 0, 0.7, sum(hajj.amount) fill accent radius 2
    tick index + 0.5, dayname(today)
form hajj, "Add to the list"
list hajj
describe:
Hajj, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- hajj: amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Total goal": money, starts at 750000.
Shows:
- the total amount of hajj out of goal with a progress bar, labelled "saved".
- text: "Progress bar", the result of goal minus the total amount of hajj divided by the larger of how many hajj entries and 1 rounded.
- a form to add a hajj.
- a list of hajj; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
